assumptions.iso_height_mm: assumed: isocentre height above floor is not confirmed for the Force (research note 01 section D); 960 mm chosen so the table range below reaches it
assumptions.front_clearance_mm: assumed: distance from scan plane to the gantry-side end of the tabletop when fully out, about 300 mm; not confirmed for the Force. The go.Top proxy has the scan plane 250 mm behind the front cover, https://storage.mtender.gov.md/get/5f8b58c9-fd81-42ce-9714-039e18762473-1748017923777
assumptions.laser_z_mm: assumed: laser-to-scan-plane distance is not confirmed for the Force (research note 01 section D); 400 mm placeholder
assumptions.table.height_min_mm: assumed: proxy from the go.Top table (vertical travel 51.5 to 90 cm), https://storage.mtender.gov.md/get/5f8b58c9-fd81-42ce-9714-039e18762473-1748017923777; Force value unconfirmed
assumptions.table.height_max_mm: assumed: proxy from the go.Top table (vertical travel 51.5 to 90 cm), https://storage.mtender.gov.md/get/5f8b58c9-fd81-42ce-9714-039e18762473-1748017923777; Force value unconfirmed
assumptions.table.height_min_in_bore_mm: assumed: lowest tabletop height at which the table can travel into the bore without touching it; chosen to be at most iso_height_mm - 150
assumptions.table.long_max_mm: assumed: proxy from the go.Top scannable range of 200 cm, https://storage.mtender.gov.md/get/5f8b58c9-fd81-42ce-9714-039e18762473-1748017923777; chosen so the default feet-first path fits
assumptions.table.long_speed_mm_s: assumed: proxy from the go.Top maximum table feed of 200 mm/s, https://storage.mtender.gov.md/get/5f8b58c9-fd81-42ce-9714-039e18762473-1748017923777; Force value unconfirmed
assumptions.table.vertical_speed_mm_s: assumed: proxy from the go.Top vertical speed of 28.3 mm/s, https://storage.mtender.gov.md/get/5f8b58c9-fd81-42ce-9714-039e18762473-1748017923777; Force value unconfirmed
assumptions.table.length_mm: assumed: tabletop length 2000 mm, not confirmed
assumptions.table.feet_first_anchor_mm: assumed: simulator convention, feet 120 mm from the gantry-side end of the tabletop
assumptions.table.head_first_anchor_mm: assumed: simulator convention, vertex 300 mm from the gantry-side end of the tabletop
assumptions.rotation_times_s: assumed: only 0.25 s, 0.5 s and 1.0 s appear in research note 01; the full rotation-time list is unconfirmed
assumptions.topogram.lengths_mm: assumed: proxy from the go.Top range of 128 to 1,680 mm and the older list, https://storage.mtender.gov.md/get/5f8b58c9-fd81-42ce-9714-039e18762473-1748017923777
assumptions.topogram.speed_mm_s: assumed: derived from job-aid examples (256 mm in 2.04 s and 512 mm in 3.32 s, about 125 to 155 mm/s); the stated Force spec is unconfirmed
assumptions.topogram.kv_options: assumed: subset of the scan kV options offered for the topogram; the Force list is unconfirmed
assumptions.ctdi_mgy_per_100mas: assumed: no Force value in the notes; 8.0 mGy per 100 mAs at 120 kV (32 cm phantom) scaled with kV to the power 2.6 for other settings
assumptions.reference_dw_mm: assumed: 320 mm, the 32 cm body phantom diameter, https://www.aapm.org/pubs/ctprotocols/documents/adultabdomenpelvisct.pdf
assumptions.modulation_strength: assumed: tube-current modulation strength 0.5, a simulator tuning value with no source; scansim/ct/dose.py maps it to exp(strength*ln2/25 per mm), so +50 mm of water-equivalent diameter gives 2x mAs at 0.5
assumptions.recon_images_per_s: assumed: simulator tuning value, 20 images per second
assumptions.rotor_spinup_s: assumed: simulator tuning value, 8 s for the rotor to reach speed
